items.title: Per the Celtics, this afternoon, they assigned Chris Cenac Jr. and transferred Devin Carter, Dillon Mitchell and Amari Williams to their G League affiliate for their practice at the Auerbach Center.
items.author: Bobby Krivitsky
items.body_excerpt:
Per the Celtics, this afternoon, they assigned Chris Cenac Jr. and transferred Devin Carter, Dillon Mitchell and Amari Williams to their G League affiliate for their practice at the Auerbach Center.

Following the conclusion of the practice, Cenac Jr. and Mitchell returned to the parent club.

media.description: The Maine Celtics have a loaded roster this season. However, it might be best for Devin Carter's development if he remains with the parent club.

quote.author: Bobby Krivitsky
quote.text:
When Devin Carter signed with the Celtics, he became the favorite for Boston's final two-way deal. That never changed.

I'm anticipating that Milos Uzan, Tucker DeVries, Gabe McGlothan, and Hayden Gray will be part of a loaded Maine Celtics roster.
